Question 14

The length of a curve y=f(x) is given by ∫0π1+cos2⁡xdx. Which of the following could be an equation for this curve?

a
y=3−sin⁡x
b
y=sin⁡2x
c
y=2+sin2⁡x
d
y=4+cos2⁡x
e
y=5−cos⁡x
